newsitem.title: DUBAI: SOCCER-LONG-RANGE IRAQI SHOT DEFEATS IRAN.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-LONG-RANGE IRAQI SHOT DEFEATS IRAN.

text.p: Iraq defeated former battlefield enemy Iran 2-1 on Wednesday in a Group B match in the Asian Cup finals in the United Arab Emirates.

Urged on by some 2,000 supporters chanting 'With our souls and blood we redeem you Iraq', the Iraqi team produced a good performance and scarcely resembled a side that had played little football in the past seven years.
Iraq has been under U.N. sanctions for six-and-a-half years. Since they were imposed, the national side has not played an international game in Baghdad.
The match was settled in the 71st minute when substitute Khalid Sabbar hit an unstoppable shot from 25 metres which silenced some 10,000 Iranians at Dubai's al-Maktoom stadium.
Besides the three points which eases Iraq's path into the second round, the result had obvious significance for two countries who were at war between 1980-88.
Political problems have persisted but the match proved to be a clean one. Both sets of fans, although chanting slogans and waving national flags, were also well behaved.
After a tight opening, the match came alive in the 27th minute when Ali Shaniyn header brought a superb single-handed save from Iranian keeper Nima Nakisa.
Five minutes later Iranian forward Khodadad Azizi missed a free header from six metres out, but the deadlock was finally broken in the 37th minute.
Husam Naji ran on to a through ball into the box from midfielder Laith Shihaib, shielded the ball from an Iranian defender and hammered in a left-foot shot from a very tight angle.
Iran pressed forward in the second half in search of an equaliser, but the Iraqi defence held steady and looked dangerous on the break, as Sabbar's strike was to prove.
Iranian star striker Ali Daei scored a consolation goal in injury time, picking himself up to score from the spot after being brought down in the box.

Iran: 22-Nima Nakisa; 3-Ali Akbar Ostadasadli; 4-Karim Bagheri; 5-Mohammad Peiravany; 6-Sirous Dinmohammadi (7-Ali Mansourian) 60; 9-Hamid Reza Estili; 10-Ali Daei; 11-Khodadad Azizi; 12-Mahdi Mahdavikia; 14-Mohammad Khakpour; 19-Ali Akbar Yousefi.

Iraq: 1-Emad Hassan (22-Jalil Agool); 2-Samir Hassan; 3- Walid Afat; 4-Abdul Jabar Hanoon; 5-Radhi Swadi; 6-Esam Salem; 9-Ali Shaniyn (7-Khaled Sabbar 50); 10-Qahtan Drain; 12-Hayder Majeed; 15-Husam Naji; 17-Laith Shihaib.
